WHEN THE NETWORK IS DOWN — the till keeps trading
Two rules to teach: (1) a queued sale is a real sale — do not ring it again; (2) anything that needs the server is unavailable while offline — clock in / out, a card
charge on the reader, a return lookup, a client search, a web order. Take cash, or hold the sale until the connection is back.
